restaurantName: Marco's New York Italian - Media City
bio: Marco's New York Italian is an American and Italian inspired restaurant from one of Britain's top celebrity chefs, Marco Pierre White.  Located in Salford's buzzing Media City, Marco's New York Italian brings a unique twist on the classic Afternoon Tea.  The contemporary, vibrant interior combined with its laid back atmosphere, provides the perfect place to sit back and indulge in a delicious Afternoon Tea.
pageTitle: Marco's New York Italian - Media City
